root_cause.text: The mtk_gate structures were incorrectly annotated with __initconst, causing them to be placed in a freed init memory region even though they are accessed at runtime after kernel boot.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes `__initconst` from several `static const struct mtk_gate` arrays in clk-mt7981-eth.c and clk-mt8516.c, with the commit message explicitly stating that since the referenced refactoring (commit 8ceff24a754a) the structs are used at runtime, not just during initialization. This mismatch between the annotation and actual usage leads to use-after-free when the kernel reclaims init memory.

intent_record.how: The array is no longer placed in an init section that is freed after kernel initialization; it now persists in memory throughout runtime, preventing potential use-after-free or invalid memory access when the clock data is accessed after boot.
